T1_early_entry.key_feature: Enters at 0.06 m instead of 0.08 m

T2_hold_outside_band.key_feature: Holds recenter priority while converging outside band

T3_early_entry_plus_hold.key_feature: Combines T1 and T2 (no additional benefit)

T4_stronger_authority.key_feature: Uniform stronger position caps and aggressive damping

T5_band_limited_balanced.key_feature: Graduated authority by band state (5 levels)

root_cause_analysis.primary_issue: Systemic mismatch between aggressive ±0.08 m target and conservative baseline tuning
contributing_factors: Late entry threshold (0.08 m) allows momentum to build
Insufficient authority for moderate drift (4.0 → 5.0 Nm only 25% boost)
Uniform response regardless of drift magnitude
root_cause_analysis.why_t5_wins: Graduated authority provides light touch for small drift, strong intervention for large drift, achieving both band control and stability

observations.t1_t2_t3_identical: T1, T2, and T3 produced identical telemetry, suggesting either approach (early entry OR hold) saturates improvement and bottleneck shifts to authority levels
observations.all_tuned_tied_at_0p10: All five variants achieved identical 5.0% outside ±0.10 m, indicating ±0.10 m target is achievable
observations.0p08_still_challenging: Even T5 spends 25% of time outside ±0.08 m, suggesting this band may require MPC or more sophisticated control
observations.no_aggressive_behavior: All variants remained stable with lower wheel RMS than baseline
observations.graduated_authority_wins: T5's five-level graduated response outperforms T4's uniform boost
